INVALID_WORK_HOURS: Work end must be after work start.

INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Only PNG, JPG or SVG files are allowed.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file must be 2 MB or smaller.
LIST_ITEM_HIDDEN: This item is hidden and can't be chosen.

DUPLICATE_FINGERPRINT_ID: Another employee already has this fingerprint ID.
DUPLICATE_INSURANCE_NUMBER: Another employee already has this insurance number.
INVALID_MANAGER: The direct manager must be another active employee.
MANAGER_LOOP: This manager would create a reporting loop.
MANAGER_NOT_MANAGING: The direct manager must hold a job title that manages people.
PROBATION_BEFORE_HIRE: The probation end can’t be before the hire date.
VIOLATION_RETIRED: This violation is retired and can't be used.
INVALID_LEVELS: Levels must be numbered 1 to 5 with no gaps.
PENALTY_NOT_PENDING: This penalty isn't waiting for approval any more.
VIOLATION_ONCE_PER_DAY: This violation counts once per day, and this employee already has one on this date.
PENALTY_EARLIER_PENDING: Approve or cancel the {date} penalty for this violation first.

PENALTY_RECOUNT_UNCONFIRMED.zero: Approving this penalty raises the level of approved penalties. Check them and confirm.
PENALTY_RECOUNT_UNCONFIRMED.one: Approving this penalty raises the level of 1 approved penalty. Check it and confirm.

PENALTY_RECOUNT_CHANGED: The approved penalties this approval changes are no longer the same. Check the new list and confirm again.
PENALTY_RECOUNT_MONTH_LOCKED: This would raise the level of an approved penalty in {month}, whose payroll is approved. Corrections for an approved month go into the next month as adjustments.
PAYROLL_APPROVED: This month's payroll is approved and locked.
PAYROLL_NOT_APPROVED: Available only after the payroll is approved.
PAYROLL_FINALIZED: This month's salaries were already transferred (finalized); it can't go back to HR.
PAYROLL_RUN_EXISTS: A payroll run already exists for this month.
PENDING_PENALTIES: Decide this month's penalties that are still waiting for approval first.
EMPLOYEE_NOT_IN_RUN: This employee is not in this payroll run.
AUDIT_NOT_RECORDED: The change could not be recorded in the activity log, so it was not saved. Please try again.
LAST_SYSTEM_ADMIN: This is the last active System admin. Give the role to another user first.
EMAIL_TAKEN: Another user already has this email.
WRONG_PASSWORD: The current password is not right.
UNKNOWN_ROLE: One of the chosen roles does not exist.
UNKNOWN_EMPLOYEE: The chosen employee does not exist.
EMPLOYEE_ALREADY_LINKED: This employee record already belongs to another user.
SYSTEM_ADMIN_UNDELETABLE: The System admin role can’t be deleted: someone must always hold every permission.
ROLE_IN_USE: Users still hold this role. Take it away from them first.
SYSTEM_ADMIN_FIXED: The System admin always holds every permission; its permissions can't be changed.
DUPLICATE_PERMISSION: A permission is listed more than once.
INVALID_SCOPE: This permission is about the whole school; it can only cover everyone.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose your own password first. You signed in with a temporary one.
SAME_PASSWORD: Choose a password different from the one you signed in with.
OUTBOX_NOT_DEAD: Only a delivery that failed for good can be retried.
NOTIFICATION_TYPE_REQUIRED: This kind of notification can't be turned off.
PENALTY_WRONG_STEP: This penalty has moved on: someone else acted on it first. Refresh to see where it stands.
PENALTY_OWN: You can't review, approve, reject or cancel a penalty given to you.
PENALTY_STAGE_REQUIRED: This employee works in several stages. Choose the stage where the violation happened.
PENALTY_STAGE_INVALID: Choose one of this employee's stages.
INVALID_OTHER_STAGES: Pick other stages than the main stage, each once, from the stages in use.
SYSTEM_ADMIN_ONLY: Only a System admin can give or take away the System admin role, or change a System admin's account.
GRANT_EXCEEDS_OWN: You can only give permissions you hold yourself, reaching no further than yours.
OWN_ACCESS_CHANGE: You can't change your own roles or employee record. Ask another administrator.
ROLE_HELD_BY_YOU: You can't change or delete a role you hold yourself. Ask another administrator.
ROLE_HELD_BY_SYSTEM_ADMIN: Only a System admin can change or delete a role a System admin holds.
PENALTY_EARLIER_PENDING_ELSEWHERE: An earlier penalty for this violation, in another stage, is still waiting. It must be approved or cancelled first.
PAYROLL_OWN_LINE: You can't add or remove an adjustment on your own payroll line. Ask someone else.
PAYROLL_APPROVER_ADJUSTED_OWN_LINE: You adjusted your own line in this month's payroll, so someone else must approve it.
EMPLOYEE_LINK_ADMIN_ONLY: Only a System admin can choose who an account is in HR.
PENALTY_RECOUNT_MONTH_LOCKED_ELSEWHERE: This would raise the level of an approved penalty, in another stage, in a month whose payroll is approved. Corrections for an approved month go into the next month as adjustments.
OWN_PAY_CHANGE: You can't change your own pay, insurance or lateness. Ask someone else.
LINKED_ACCOUNT_ADMIN_ONLY: Only a System admin can set a temporary password, change the email or unlock the sign-in of an account linked to an employee record.
UNLINKED_PAY_ROLE: This account has no employee record, so it can't be given a role that acts on pay or penalties. A System admin must link it first.
ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED: Link your account to your employee record first. Ask a System admin.
ROLE_HAS_UNLINKED_HOLDER: Someone holding this role has no employee record. A System admin must link them first (deactivated accounts count too).
OWN_CONTRACT: You can't decide on your own contract. Ask someone else.
CONTRACT_DECIDED: This contract already has a decision.
EARLY_TERMINATION_PENDING: An early termination request is waiting. Approve or reject it first.
CONTRACT_NO_NOTICE: There is no notice from the employee to withdraw.
CONTRACT_END_DATE_INVALID: Choose an end date from today on, within the contract's dates.
CONTRACT_END_MONTH_LOCKED: The payroll of {month} is approved, so the contract can't end before that month's end.

EARLY_TERMINATION_NOT_PENDING: There is no early termination request waiting. A rejected request can't be approved; record a new one.

CONTRACT_NOT_TO_DEACTIVATE: Only employees whose contract ended without renewal can be deactivated here.
